Anna (AE): quick sync - Lantern wants to validate drop-in compat with CompetitorX. scope: prompt parity, structured JSON outputs, pricing for a 3-week POC, and security Qs. can we get acceptance gates today?
Leo (Solutions Eng): yes. plan: golden set (80 prompts), schema tests (40), and edge probes (20). metrics: semantic_sim >= 0.9, json_valid >= 98%, behavioral_flip <= 5%.
Priya (SRE): staging cluster ready. need to know if we should preserve their X-Client-ID header and conversation ids. also will provide egress IPs when deployed.
Maya (Security): Lantern's questionnaire flag: 72h deletion request for PII. our standard is 30d. legal signoff required for exception. will draft answers for SOC2, KMS, SSO + SCIM.
Ethan (Sales): proposing $1.5k credits + refundable $500 ramp fee for network tests. Lantern asked for a three-week window.
Leo (Solutions Eng): small compatibility shim recommended: normalize whitespace, strip vendor system markers, and enforce our system prompt. sample pseudo-config: normalize:true, strip_prefix:["\u2063SYS\u2063"], system_prompt:"You are concise."
Priya (SRE): perf run scheduled: 2024-06-12T02:00:00Z. infra-bot deployed staging endpoint: https://staging.redwood.dev/lantern-poc. egress IPs: 3.101.55.10, 3.101.55.11. creds in 1Password.
infra-bot: deployment complete for project lantern-poc. perf run will post logs to https://infra/logs/lantern-poc.
Anna (AE): action items: Leo -> harness + first diff by Thu EOD; Maya -> security draft by EOD; Priya -> confirm perf run and share any autoscale notes; Ethan -> send written POC credit proposal. 30m review booked Fri 9am PT.
Leo (Solutions Eng): will attach curl snippets and the diff CSV to this thread when ready.
Maya (Security): flagging deletion SLA as potential blocker. looping Legal.
Ethan (Sales): ping me if we need to tweak the quoted credits.
Anna (AE): thanks all. reconvene after perf run. :rocket:
